edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender at construction
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from account
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender] before moving funds
onlyOwner modifier on enablePurchasing requires msg.sender == owner
onlyOwner modifier on disablePurchasing requires msg.sender == owner
fallback mints tokens to balances[msg.sender]
block.timestamp is used as event data inside the payable fallback (timestamp dependency)
fallback executes the external owner.transfer(amount) call before updating balances
external ETH transfer occurs while balances state is still stale, enabling reentrant state inconsistency
fallback computes tokensIssued = amount * 1000 without overflow protection
fallback overwrites tokensIssued with 800 ether in the hacked-mode branch
fallback performs balances[msg.sender] + tokensIssued overflow check

transferFrom delegates the actual movement to internal transferring

_from parameter flows into transferring source balance update

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient parameter consumed entirely by the transferring balance update, so it can be normalized into the transferring function
_value is only meaningful inside transfer() and folds into the transfer amount handling
_amount is consumed by the transferring subtraction/addition logic and can be merged into transferring
_from is a transient parameter used only for the balances[_from] update inside transferring
_spender is only used in the approve() allowance write and can be normalized into approve
_owner is only a lookup key in balanceOf and can be merged into balanceOf
local amount is only used to derive tokensIssued via the unchecked multiplication, so it folds into that unsafe operation
local tokensIssued is only consumed by the unchecked balance addition, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation
